children: on Monday it priced an underwritten public offering of $400M of 6.70% notes due Oct. 8, 2029.
The 6.70% notes will mature in October 2029, with interest payable twice a year.
Closing of the offering is expected on Oct. 8, subject to customary conditions.
The company plans to allocate the proceeds toward existing debt, fund investments, and other corporate needs.
